entry.title: Diffusion Time Series Imputation for Air Quality Monitoring
entry.summary: Air quality stations often lose readings during maintenance. We apply diffusion time series imputation to fill these gaps and compare it with interpolation and matrix completion across forty monitoring stations.

entry.title: Wavelet Features for Diffusion Time Series Imputation
entry.summary: We decompose each series with a wavelet transform before running the diffusion model, which helps diffusion time series imputation recover both slow trends and sharp events.

entry.title: Diffusion Time Series Imputation Under Distribution Shift
entry.summary: Imputation models are usually tested on data drawn from the training distribution. We measure how diffusion time series imputation degrades under distribution shift and propose a simple test-time adaptation step.
